Package wellen

Class MidiOut

java.lang.Object
wellen.MidiOut
public class MidiOut extends Object
sends MIDI messages to a MIDI output device.

all values are clamped to their valid ranges ( channel 0–15, data 0–127, pitch bend 0–16383 ).

  • Field Details

    • USE_LEGACY_DEVICE_INDEX

      @Deprecated public static boolean USE_LEGACY_DEVICE_INDEX
      Deprecated.
      only use this to keep old sketches working that rely on the old ( wrong ) device numbering.
      if true MidiOut(int) interprets the ID as an index into all MIDI devices ( behavior before v0.14 ). by default the ID refers to the list printed by Wellen.dumpMidiOutputDevices().

    • can_send_clock_and_sysex

      public boolean can_send_clock_and_sysex()
      java's built-in MIDI implementation on macOS can not send MIDI clock ( 0xF8, 0xFA, 0xFB, 0xFC ) or SysEx messages to MIDI ports. messages are silently dropped. adding CoreMIDI4J to the classpath ( e.g the sketch's code folder ) fixes this.
      Returns:
      false if this output is known to drop clock and SysEx messages

      public void close()
      closes the receiver and closes the device if it was opened by wellen and is not used anymore. messages sent after closing are ignored.
